texts.preamble: A.Sampath Kumar vs The Tahsildar on 20 December, 2017 Author: S.Vaidyanathan Bench: S.Vaidyanathan In The High Court Of Judicature At Madras Dated: 20.12.2017 Coram: The Honourable Mr.Justice S.Vaidyanathan W.P.No.33012 of 2017 and W.M.P.No.36375 of 2017 A.Sampath Kumar .. Petitioner Vs. 1. The Tahsildar, Egmore-Nungambakkam, Chennai-3. 2. The Commissioner, Greater Chennai Corporation, Ripon Building, Chennai-600 003. .. Respondents Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, praying for issuance For Petitioner : Ms.N.R.Jasmine Padma For Respondents : Mr.S.Diwakar, Spl.G.P. for R-1 Mr.T.C.Gopalakrishnan for R-2 Order
texts.facts: The petitioner has come forward with this Writ Petition praying for issuance of a Writ of Mandamus to direct the second respondent to consider and pass orders on the representation, dated 08.12.2017 for grant of Trade Licence for the petitioner's petty shop located at Mchnicols Lane, Chetpet, Chennai-3 on merits and as per law within a time as stipulated by this Court. 2. It is the case of the petitioner that on application to the Commissioner for Adi Dravidar Welfare A.Sampath Kumar vs The Tahsildar on 20 December, 2017 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/171434185/ 1 Department towards grant of lease/allotment to run a petty shop, he was allotted a piece of land measuring an extent of 0048 Sq.Ft. in R.S.No.365, located at Mchnicols Lane, Chetpet, Chennai-3, classified as Road Poramboke, vide proceedings of the first respondent, dated 11.10.2004 with certain conditions. The petitioner is running the petty shop as on date and had been remitting the rent as prescribed without default till date. The petitioner is eking out his livelihood on the income derived from the said petty shop. He has also obtained Certificate of Registration under Food Safety and Standards Act, which is valid upto May 2018. Since the second respondent interfered with the possession of the petitioner in respect of the said petty shop, the petitioner sent a representation, dated 08.12.2017 to the second respondent seeking trade certificate and till then, not to disturb the petitioner's possession of the said petty shop. Since the said representation is not yet considered, the petitioner has filed this Writ Petition for the relief stated supra.
